description: Source code for DTX (Discontinuous Transmission) encoder functions in AMR speech codec, including initialization, reset, exit, buffer handling, SID parameter calculation, and DTX hangover management.

methods.name: dtx_enc_init
methods.description: Allocates and initializes the DTX encoder state.

methods.name: dtx_enc_reset
methods.description: Resets the DTX encoder state to default values.

methods.name: dtx_enc
methods.description: Calculates SID parameters in DTX mode, updates energy and LSP buffers.

methods.name: dtx_buffer
methods.description: Handles the DTX buffer, updates LSP and energy history.

methods.name: tx_dtx_handler
methods.description: Manages DTX hangover and VAD decision, updates mode and hangover counters.
